'''Iyuta spaceport''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Takari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]]. Docking facilities at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] were expensive, even for mediocre amenities.<ref name="Plant" />
